blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Elevated gold and copper prices drove a 56-percent surge in Philex Mining Corp.’s core earnings in the third quarter, more than offsetting a decline in production. On Friday, the mining company reported in a disclosure that core net income of P537 million from July to September, up from P344 million in the same period last year. READ: Philex operations continue despite strike Reported net income rose faster, up 72 percent to P310 million from P180 million, while operating revenues rose 6 percent to P2.67 billion.
